title: Detective Bolt and the Missing Smile | Thinking About How Others Feel
lesson: Before you laugh or try to fix things, stop and ask: how would they feel? Then listen.
description: Luna's balloon rocket goes PFFFBBBT the day before Science Day, and everyone laughs. Later, Luna has not shared a single fun fact all day! Detective Bolt opens the case of the missing smile, but the clues lead somewhere he never expected. A funny mystery about empathy, saying sorry and trying again.

lines.text: Three, two, one... launch!
PFFFBBBT! Luna's balloon rocket zoomed up, flipped over, and spun around and around and around.
Whoa! It's doing loop-the-loops!
Then it landed, very gently, right on top of Grandpa Shell.
Oh! A visitor. Hello, little balloon. Would you like some tea?
Everybody laughed. And Bolt laughed the loudest of all.
Ha. Ha. Ha. PFFFBBBT! Play it again! Rocket landing on a turtle! Best science ever!
Ha... ha. Yes. Very funny. I have to go now.
Science Day was tomorrow. Everyone laughed. Well... almost everyone.
Detective Bolt reporting. We have a mystery. Luna has not said one single fun fact today.
Not one? She usually says a fact every five minutes. Even in her sleep!
I asked her what was wrong. She said, quote, I'm fine. So she is fine. Case closed. Beep.
Wait. How did she say it?
I recorded it. Playing now. I'm... fine.
Uh-oh. That is not a fine fine. That is a not-fine fine.
There are different fines? Nobody told me! My instruction book has zero pages about this!
Sometimes words say one thing, but a face says another. You have to look at the face. And the voice.
Face, voice, words. Three clues. This case is harder than I computed. I will cheer her up with two plans.
Luna was sitting by the river. Her book was open. But she was not reading it.
Hello, Luna. Plan one: make Luna laugh. Here is the funniest sound I know. PFFFBBBT!
Luna did not laugh. Her feathers drooped even lower.
Strange. That sound worked this morning. Plan two: a present. I found you a very good rock.
That is... a very good rock. Thank you, Bolt. But I want to be alone right now.
Plan one failed. Plan two failed. I have no plan three. This has never happened before.
Back in the meadow, Detective Bolt did what detectives do. He looked at the evidence again.
Replaying this morning. Slow motion. Look at Luna's face when the rocket fell.
Her feathers went all flat. Like a sad pancake. She worked on that rocket for a whole week.
And then we all laughed. Really loud.
Zooming in on the loudest laugh. Who is that? It is a small robot. A very shiny small robot.
The detective found the culprit. A culprit is the one who did it. And the culprit is... ME?!
We laughed too, Bolt. We didn't mean to be mean. It just looked funny.
Running a test. What if I built something for a week, and it went wrong, and my friends laughed?
Result: my circuits feel heavy. Like a backpack full of rocks. Very good rocks. But heavy.
That's it! That's how Luna feels! You figured it out by putting yourself in her place!
New plan. Not a plan to make her laugh. A plan to say sorry. And then listen.
Grandpa Shell walked the friends to Luna's tree, slow and steady, holding a lantern. Owls like to stay up late.
Luna. This morning I laughed the loudest. I did not think about how you felt. I am sorry.
Me too, Luna. We all laughed. We're really sorry.
Thank you. I worked so hard on it. And tomorrow the whole village will watch. What if they laugh again?
Bolt wanted to say ten plans at once. But this time, he just listened.
That sounds really hard. Being scared about tomorrow. Do you want help? Only if you want it.
Yes. I think I do. I read about this! The balloon needs a string to follow, through a straw. My string came untied.
She's saying facts again! The smile is coming back!
Well, look at that. A detective who solves mysteries with his ears. The best kind.
The next day, the string was tied tight. Milo held one end. Pepper held the other.
Air rushes out the back of the balloon, so the balloon zooms forward. Let's see it!
On three! One, two, THREE!
ZOOOOM! The balloon rocket flew straight along the string, all the way across the square.
And this time, everybody cheered. Even Luna.
Case closed. The best detective tool is not a magnifying glass. It is asking: how would they feel?
Thanks, Bolt. And you can keep the very good rock. It can be our lucky rock.
Question. Is it okay to laugh at PFFFBBBT now?
Now? Yes! Because now it's funny for everyone!
PFFFBBBT! The balloon came loose, zipped back, and landed gently on Grandpa Shell. Again.
Oh, you're back! I saved you some tea.
When a friend feels sad, try standing in their shoes, then listen with your heart. See you next time in Maple Hollow!
